Choose the Leader’s Affiliation and Archetype. Maintain at least three Outcast Hive Scum per Champion. Outcast fighters within 6 inches of their Leader automatically pass Nerve checks and ignore Fearsome.

At creation each Leader and Champion gains 1 additional TP for Trading Post equipment. The first Visit Trading Post action each post-cycle generates 1 additional TP.

Choose Cawdor, Delaque, Escher, Goliath, Van Saar or Orlock. Counts as that House for campaigns and scenarios; Leaders and Champions may buy its restricted equipment, including Pets, at creation and post-cycle.

May earn 20 credits as a Post-cycle Action. While on the battlefield, once per battle may force the opponent to reroll a Lasting Injury roll. Has a fighting knife; no additional equipment.

Prime Bomb Rat is a Single action using an equipped, available Blast (3 or 5 inch) grenade and its Ammo test. Place the rat touching the user and activate it immediately; later rats activate after Priority before models. Within9 inches of its owner its direction is chosen, otherwise use Scatter. It moves6 inches straight, ignores terrain slowing, has Clamber and automatically jumps gaps up to2 inches; larger gaps and impassable terrain stop it. Within1 inch of another model it stops: on2+ its grenade explodes centred on the rat, on1 it escapes. Attacks against it have−1 to hit; after a hit the grenade explodes on4+. Remove the rat after either outcome.

The rider gains Mounted and Agile, receives+1 on Agility tests and uses Movement8 inches. Dash adds5 inches instead of Initiative.

During the bearer’s activation, attacks with their close combat weapons gain Blaze(5+). A weapon that already has Blaze is unchanged.

Gains Mounted and Flying, sets Movement9 inches and uses+5 inches instead of Initiative when Dashing. Includes Cutter grenade launchers with frag and krak grenades. At recruitment or a Post-cycle Sequence, replace these with Cutter heavy stubbers for+10credits or Cutter plasma guns for+15credits.

Increase Movement by2 inches, including above its normal maximum. Vertical climbing distance is not halved. It cannot be combined with a servo-harness.

The Arbitrator sets the dates. Give each gang a Settlement and one random starting territory. Generate 9/12/15/18/21/24 contested territories for 3/4/5/6/7/8 players, allowing repeats. A gang chooses whether to use its own starting-territory table before rolling.

Issue one challenge per cycle. The first cycle uses random order; later cycles use increasing Gang Rating with tied gangs rolling off. Stake an uncontrolled territory during Occupation, or an opponent-held one if none remain; during Takeover stake an opponent-held territory. Declining normally concedes it, except later challenges received after issuing one or a second or subsequent incoming challenge that cycle. Further challenges are allowed after all outstanding battles are played if time remains.
The winner claims or retains the staked territory. An Occupation draw returns an uncontrolled stake to the pool; a Takeover draw leaves it with its previous owner.

Repeat for obstacles and small features. Agreed Tunnel Warfare places the ceiling at one wall section, preventing climbing over walls and using stairs or ladders.

Starting with the defender, alternate placing one model in its deployment zone. When one player is finished, deploy all remaining models of the other starting crew.
